verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Oyster serves an llms.txt at docs.oysterhr.com (HTTP 200) that indexes API endpoints and guides such as engagements, benefits and reseller workflows. Docs pages are also served as .md files, which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: no documented guidance on using the docs with agents, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other expanded agent-oriented content.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.oysterhr.com/llms.txt # Oyster Public API Documentation
Retrieve all engagements: Returns a list of engagements
This guide will help Resellers use the API to manage their customers and take actions on their behalf.
